item.title: Train Strikes Vehicle At Cantonment Crossing Sunday Night
item.description: A train struck a vehicle Sunday night in Cantonment. For an unknown reason, the passenger car was on the railroad tracks on Highway 95A at East Kingsfield Road when it was struck by a CSX train around 11:05 p.m., pushing the car away from the crossing. item.title: James Madison Top Troy To Win Sun Belt Women’s Basketball Title In Pensacola
item.description: James Madison defeated Troy 69–52 on Monday afternoon to take the 2026 Visit Pensacola Sun Belt Women’s Basketball Championship title. James Madison claimed its second title in four years, after winning their first tournament title in 2023. Earning the league’s auto bid James Madison will make its 14th NCAA tournament appearance.
